stem:
Falguni labels the corners of a square $W$, $X$, $Y$, $Z$ in order going around the boundary. A valid name may start at any corner and then follow that travel order.

Which name is valid for that square?

options.text: Square $XYZW$ is valid: it lists corners in boundary travel order, starting at $X$.
Square $WYZX$, listing corners by jumping across instead of travelling the boundary.
Only square $WXYZ$ is allowed; starting at any other corner makes the name invalid.
Square $WXYZ$ is valid only after renaming the corners in alphabetical order first.

teacher.key_rationale: XYZW travels the boundary from X. Jumping across swaps the travel-order idea. Allowing only WXYZ omits that any start is fine. Requiring alphabetical renaming reverses name-from-labels.
